project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is named in the headline: 'BTU Acquires Two Extensive Gold Properties in the Active Wawa Gold District; The Echum Gold Project Adjacent to Alamos Gold and The Hubcap Gold Project Adjacent to Red Pine Exploration'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'BTU METALS CORP. ("BTU" or the "Company") announces it has entered into a purchase and sale agreement pursuant to which the Company will purchase, upon closing, a 100% interest in two large gold exploration projects... the Echum Gold Project...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, BTU Metals Corp., is identified in the signature block of the press release: 'ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD "Paul Wood" Paul Wood, CEO, Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The press release states that BTU will acquire a full interest: 'BTU will purchase an undivided 100% interest in and to 763 mining claims...'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly referred to as a gold project in the headline: 'BTU Acquires Two Extensive Gold Properties in the Active Wawa Gold District; The Echum Gold Project...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article directly reports on the acquisition of the Echum project by BTU Metals Corp., which is the subject of this analysis.

currency.justification: The currency for the cash portion of the deal is explicitly stated as Canadian dollars: 'The consideration payable by BTU on closing for a 100% interest in the Echum and Hubcap properties is: CAD$25,000 and 5 million BTU treasury common shares.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The project's share is $12,500, calculated as half of the CAD$25,000 cash consideration for the two properties (Echum and Hubcap) as stated: 'The consideration payable by BTU on closing for a 100% interest in the Echum and Hubcap properties is: CAD$25,000 and 5 million BTU treasury common shares.'

share_payments_raw.justification: No explicit dollar value for the share payment is provided. The consideration is listed as a number of shares, not a cash-equivalent value for the shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately and not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The project's share is 2,500,000 shares, calculated as half of the 5 million shares for the two properties (Echum and Hubcap) as stated: 'The consideration payable by BTU on closing for a 100% interest in the Echum and Hubcap properties is: CAD$25,000 and 5 million BTU treasury common shares.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options are mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote for the buyer (BTU Metals Corp.): 'Last: 0.045'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text explicitly states there are 'No work commitments other than ongoing assessment work requirements with the Ontario government'.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text explicitly states there are 'No work commitments other than ongoing assessment work requirements with the Ontario government'.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: BTU is assuming the obligation for existing royalties on the properties, which are 'subject only to net smelter royalties of not more than 2% (on the majority of the claims the royalty can be reduced to not more than 1%)'.

coverage_area_raw.justification: A separate article provides the specific area for the Echum project: 'Kingsview is a mineral exploration company focused on its gold and base metal exploration properties, including the flagship 13,056-hectare Echum Project...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the area is provided in the same sentence: '...the flagship 13,056-hectare Echum Project...'

resource_size.justification: The text mentions 'historic gold mineralization' but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate in terms of mass or volume (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first line of the press release: 'BTU METALS CORP. ("BTU" or the "Company")(TSXV:BTU)'. This is confirmed by the 'Detailed Quote' section which lists 'Exchange: TSXV'.
